zh: 放弃一个空间维度：两维空间加一维时间里的广义相对论。这里 Riemann 张量完全由 Ricci 张量决定——真空处处局部平坦，没有引力波，也没有牛顿式的吸引。可它一点也不无聊：质点把平面剪掉一个角，光绕过它会出现双像；Λ < 0 时有真正的黑洞（BTZ），有温度、有熵；尘埃宇宙不减速。下面全部按 2+1 维的方程算。
en: Give up one dimension of space: general relativity in two space dimensions plus one of time. Here the Riemann tensor is entirely determined by the Ricci tensor — vacuum is locally flat everywhere, there are no gravitational waves and no Newtonian attraction. Yet it is anything but boring: a point mass cuts a wedge out of the plane and light passing it shows a double image; for Λ < 0 there are real black holes (BTZ), with a temperature and an entropy; a dust universe does not decelerate. Everything below is computed from the 2+1-dimensional equations.

zh: ① 质点是一个锥：双像，但不弯 模拟
en: ① A point mass is a cone: double image, but no bending simulated

zh: 左图是"剪开的平面"：质点（中心）的全部效应就是去掉一个角 $\delta = 8\pi G m$ 并把两条边粘上，光线是直线。右图是粘起来之后你看到的样子。拖动光源（金点；紫点是你，不能拖），看它在质点正后方时怎么分成两个像——远处光源的两像夹角恰好是 $\delta$，和距离无关。
en: On the left is the "cut plane": the entire effect of the point mass (at the center) is to remove a wedge $\delta = 8\pi G m$ and glue the two edges together; rays of light are straight lines. On the right is what you see after gluing. Drag the source (gold dot; the violet dot is you and cannot be dragged) and watch it split into two images when it is right behind the mass — for a distant source the angle between the two images is exactly $\delta$, independent of distance.

zh: 亏角 $\delta = 8\pi G m$
en: Deficit angle $\delta = 8\pi G m$

zh: 弧度；质量越大，剪掉的角越大；总亏角到 $2\pi$ 远处合拢成圆柱，到 $4\pi$（Gauss–Bonnet）空间闭合成球
en: radians; the larger the mass, the larger the wedge removed; at a total deficit of $2\pi$ the far region closes into a cylinder, at $4\pi$ (Gauss–Bonnet) space closes into a sphere

zh: ② BTZ 黑洞：没有牛顿引力也有黑洞 模拟
en: ② The BTZ black hole: a black hole without Newtonian gravity simulated

zh: $\Lambda = -1/\ell^2$ 时，$ds^2 = -f\,dt^2 + dr^2/f + r^2d\varphi^2$，$f = r^2/\ell^2 - M$。视界 $r_+ = \ell\sqrt M$，外面局部就是 AdS₃。放一个粒子（或一束光），给它能量 $E$ 和角动量 $L$，看它的轨道：AdS 像一口井，什么都飞不远；而 BTZ 里没有稳定圆轨道，有质量的东西最后都掉进去。$E$ 不够从出发点 $r_0 = r_+ + 2\ell$ 往外飞时，就从它的折返点出发往里落。
en: For $\Lambda = -1/\ell^2$, $ds^2 = -f\,dt^2 + dr^2/f + r^2d\varphi^2$ with $f = r^2/\ell^2 - M$. The horizon is at $r_+ = \ell\sqrt M$, and outside it the space is locally AdS₃. Launch a particle (or a ray of light) with energy $E$ and angular momentum $L$ and watch its orbit: AdS is like a well, nothing flies far; and in BTZ there are no stable circular orbits, everything massive eventually falls in. When $E$ is not enough to fly outward from the starting point $r_0 = r_+ + 2\ell$, it starts from its turning point and falls inward instead.

zh: 有质量的粒子
en: Massive particle

zh: 光
en: Light

zh: ✦ 发射
en: ✦ Launch

zh: 黑洞质量 $M$
en: Black-hole mass $M$

zh: 能量 $E$
en: Energy $E$

zh: 角动量 $L$
en: Angular momentum $L$

zh: ③ 2+1 维的宇宙学 模拟
en: ③ Cosmology in 2+1 dimensions simulated

zh: 2+1 维的弗里德曼方程：$H^2 + k/a^2 = 8\pi G\rho$，$\ddot a/a = -8\pi G p$。减速只来自压强：尘埃（$p=0$）的宇宙匀速膨胀，像根本没有引力；辐射才减速，Λ 才加速。巧合：2+1 维只有辐射时 $a\propto t^{2/3}$，和 3+1 维的尘埃宇宙是同一条曲线。
en: The 2+1-dimensional Friedmann equations: $H^2 + k/a^2 = 8\pi G\rho$, $\ddot a/a = -8\pi G p$. Deceleration comes only from pressure: a dust universe ($p=0$) expands at constant speed, as if there were no gravity at all; only radiation decelerates, only Λ accelerates. A coincidence: in 2+1 dimensions pure radiation gives $a\propto t^{2/3}$, the same curve as the dust universe in 3+1 dimensions.

zh: 只有尘埃只有辐射只有 Λ3+1 维的尘埃宇宙（对照；和 2+1 维"只有辐射"恰好同一条 $a\propto t^{2/3}$）
en: dust onlyradiation onlyΛ only3+1-dimensional dust universe (for reference; exactly the same $a\propto t^{2/3}$ as "radiation only" in 2+1)

zh: ④ 读完你自己的发现之后再看：这个宇宙在说什么
en: ④ Read after you have made your own discoveries: what this universe is saying

zh: 为什么没有引力。三维时空里 Riemann 张量有 6 个独立分量，Ricci 张量也是 6 个：爱因斯坦方程 $R_{\mu u} - frac12 g_{\mu u}R + \Lambda g_{\mu u} = 8\pi G T_{\mu u}$ 把曲率完全钉死在物质所在处，真空里曲率为零（或等于 Λ 给的常曲率）。没有传播的自由度：没有引力波，两个质点之间也没有力——它们各自只是一个锥。
en: Why there is no gravity. In three-dimensional spacetime the Riemann tensor has 6 independent components, and so does the Ricci tensor: the Einstein equations $R_{\mu u} - frac12 g_{\mu u}R + \Lambda g_{\mu u} = 8\pi G T_{\mu u}$ pin the curvature down completely to where the matter is, and in vacuum the curvature is zero (or the constant curvature given by Λ). There are no propagating degrees of freedom: no gravitational waves, and no force between two point masses — each is just a cone.

zh: 锥。质点 $m$ 的时空是 $ds^2 = -dt^2 + dr^2 + (1-4Gm)^2r^2d\varphi^2$：绕一圈只有 $2\pi(1-4Gm)$，亏角 $\delta = 8\pi Gm$（Deser、Jackiw、't Hooft 1984）。光走直线，但从质点两侧绕过的两条直线在粘合后都到你眼睛：双像，夹角 $\delta$。质量总和到 $1/4G$（总亏角 $2\pi$）时远处合拢成圆柱，这是 DJH 对开放空间的质量上限；到 $1/2G$（总亏角 $4\pi = 2\pi\chi(S^2)$，Gauss–Bonnet）平面闭合成球面——这就是 2+1 维的"封闭宇宙"。宇宙弦在 3+1 维里也是这样的锥。
en: The cone. The spacetime of a point mass $m$ is $ds^2 = -dt^2 + dr^2 + (1-4Gm)^2r^2d\varphi^2$: going once around covers only $2\pi(1-4Gm)$, a deficit angle $\delta = 8\pi Gm$ (Deser, Jackiw, 't Hooft 1984). Light travels in straight lines, but the two straight lines passing on either side of the mass both reach your eye after gluing: a double image, separated by $\delta$. When the total mass reaches $1/4G$ (total deficit $2\pi$) the far region closes into a cylinder — this is the DJH upper bound on the mass of an open space; at $1/2G$ (total deficit $4\pi = 2\pi\chi(S^2)$, Gauss–Bonnet) the plane closes into a sphere — that is the "closed universe" of 2+1 dimensions. Cosmic strings in 3+1 dimensions are cones of the same kind.

zh: BTZ。1992 年 Bañados、Teitelboim、Zanelli 发现 Λ < 0 时有黑洞解。它局部就是 AdS₃（没有曲率奇点），整体是 AdS₃ 的商空间，却有视界、霍金温度 $T = r_+/2\pi\ell^2$、熵 $S = 2\pi r_+/4G$。它成了量子引力的最佳试验场：Strominger 1998 年用 Brown–Henneaux 的边界中心荷 $c = 3\ell/2G$ 和 Cardy 公式算出了同一个熵——全息对偶最早的硬证据之一。
en: BTZ. In 1992 Bañados, Teitelboim and Zanelli found a black-hole solution for Λ < 0. Locally it is just AdS₃ (no curvature singularity), globally a quotient of AdS₃, yet it has a horizon, a Hawking temperature $T = r_+/2\pi\ell^2$ and an entropy $S = 2\pi r_+/4G$. It became the best testing ground of quantum gravity: in 1998 Strominger used the Brown–Henneaux boundary central charge $c = 3\ell/2G$ and the Cardy formula to compute the same entropy — one of the earliest hard pieces of evidence for the holographic duality.

zh: 宇宙学。2+1 维里 $G_{tt} = (\dot a/a)^2 + k/a^2$ 只有一项，$\ddot a/a = -8\pi G p$：尘埃不减速，这是"没有引力吸引"的宇宙学版本。③里对照的 3+1 维尘埃宇宙则按 $\ddot a/a = -4\pi G\rho/3$ 减速。
en: Cosmology. In 2+1 dimensions $G_{tt} = (\dot a/a)^2 + k/a^2$ has a single term and $\ddot a/a = -8\pi G p$: dust does not decelerate, the cosmological version of "no gravitational attraction". The 3+1-dimensional dust universe shown for reference in ③ decelerates as $\ddot a/a = -4\pi G\rho/3$.

zh: 标签：双像、轨道、势、膨胀全是方程算的（模拟）；BTZ 的熵与 Cardy 公式的对应引自文献。
en: Labels: the double image, orbits, potential and expansion are all computed from the equations (simulated); the correspondence between the BTZ entropy and the Cardy formula is quoted from the literature.
